name: King Lumber Company
old_description: King Lumber has a rich history of providing quality wood products to the market for over 50 years, standing by the business philosophies of honesty, integrity, and quality of products and services to both their customers and business partners.
about:
King Lumber Company operates from its headquarters in Forest, Mississippi, with a second production facility in Jasper, Texas. The company has supplied wood products for over 50 years, though an exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names are not specified in available sources.

The company manufactures Southern Yellow Pine dimensional lumber and decking products. Its combined facilities are capable of producing more than 45 million board feet of 1-inch Southern Yellow Pine boards annually. Standard inventory includes 1x4 and 1x6 boards in grades such as D and Better, #2, #3 GM, and #3/#4 HT, as well as 5/4x6 and 5/4x4 decking in premium and standard grades. Custom runs and special grades are available on request.

King Lumber serves customers in the building materials and construction sectors, supplying lumber and decking to distributors, contractors, and retail yards. The company also manages logistics through contracts with internal and external fleets to provide quick delivery.

The business emphasizes honesty, integrity, and quality in its products and services, principles that have guided its operations throughout its history.
